title: The exercise chart can open on a year or on all time without the free-plan check
what: When a member's last workout of an exercise is older than 3 months, the chart opens on the 1-year or all-time range by itself, and the free-plan 3-month check only runs when the range is tapped, so a free member sees older charts without being asked to upgrade.
expected: The opening range is checked the same way as a tapped range, and falls back to 3 months (or the limit pop-up) when the plan does not allow more.
who: free members, only while the 3-month chart limit is switched on
how_often: every time such an exercise page opens
fix_line: Run the same plan check on the opening range
